blocks.text: The first printed views of the Philippines and its inhabitants date back to 1602, appearing in a published account of Olivier van Noort’s three-year circumnavigation of the globe. Araling Panlipunan classes taught us about Ferdinand Magellan’s tragic expedition in 1521, but completely skipped over later circumnavigators.
